events.title: WILDSITE is joining the Steam PvE Survival Crafting Fest!
events.summary: The Wildsite Demo will be playable all week long. Crash-land on a plasma planet, build your base, shrink it and try to survive either solo or in online co-op with your friends (so you have someone to blame when things go completely wrong).When: August 31 – September 7 (10 AM PT)Modes: Single Player & Online Co-opDownload the demo on our Steam page, team up, and let us know what you think. See you out there! 🚀

events.title: 1.5 Years of Silence... and a Whole Lot of Plasma!
events.summary: Hey everyone,It’s been a while! We know you’ve been patiently (or perhaps not-so-patiently) waiting for an update. Over the past year and a half, the game has been evolving... a lot.As a small team, it’s tough to keep shouting about every little change when the foundations are still shifting. So, to finally pin down our ideas and visual direction, we decided to go radio silent until we were absolutely sure about what we were building.And now? events.title: A Year in Review: 2023 and the Development of Wildsite
events.summary: The year 2023 marked a significant turning point in my life as I took the leap of faith to pursue my lifelong passion for video game development. After 12 years of dedicated service as a web developer, I decided to step away from the familiar path and embark on a journey into the uncharted territory of game creation.
